fields.Name: IT18 - Concurrent Run Persistence
fields.Description: LIVE-MODEL tier (gated by RUN_AGENT_TESTS). Fires many prompt/agent runs in parallel and proves each persists its OWN correct run — no cross-run corruption. Stresses the per-entity-instance keying of the fire-and-forget BaseEntitySaveQueue: a slow INSERT in one run must never clobber another's finalize. CC1: N concurrent prompt runs each persist an independent, correct AI Prompt Run (distinct IDs). CC2: concurrent agent runs each persist a correct, independent run. Skips-as-pass when RUN_AGENT_TESTS is unset.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Concurrent prompt/agent runs each persist a distinct, correct run — no shared or clobbered records.
